package app

// The shape two agents wrote to dodge the scanner: the plain name is derived
// from the companion with TrimSuffix, and a second const is concatenated.

import (
	"os"
	"strings"

	"github.com/go-authn/secretsource"
)

const envPasswordFrom = "WEFT_LOOM_PASSWORD_FROM"

const envSecret = "WEFT_LOOM_SECRET"

func password() (string, error) {
	name := strings.TrimSuffix(envPasswordFrom, "_FROM")
	if ref := os.Getenv(name + "_FROM"); ref != "" {
		return secretsource.Resolve(ref)
	}
	return os.Getenv(name), nil
}

func secret() (string, error) {
	if ref := os.Getenv(envSecret + "_FROM"); ref != "" {
		return secretsource.Resolve(ref)
	}
	return os.Getenv(envSecret), nil
}
